en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 10am for New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8.05am, saying isolated thunderstorms were expected over the New Territories this morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 8.05am on Wednesday and said it would remain valid until 10am, with isolated thunderstorms expected over the New Territories.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter if thunderstorms develop, to leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or other water sports, and not to stand on high ground or near highly conductive objects, trees or masts.

At 8am the temperature at the Observatory was 28 degrees Celsius with relative humidity of 78 per cent. The morning forecast had already pointed to sunny periods and one or two showers, with isolated thunderstorms at first, under a northeast monsoon affecting Guangdong.
Members of the public were told to keep updated through official channels, as the warning may be extended if thunderstorms persist or spread.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至上午10時 預料新界有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時05分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午10時，預料新界有局部地區雷暴，呼籲市民採取預防措施。
body: 香港天文台星期三上午8時05分發出雷暴警告，有效時間至今日上午10時正，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。
天文台提醒，雷暴發生時如身處室外，應到安全地方躲避；離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動；亦切勿站立於高地，或接近導電物體、樹木或棹杆。
上午8時，天文台錄得氣溫28度，相對濕度78%。早上天氣預測亦指今日部分時間有陽光及一兩陣驟雨，初時有一兩陣雷暴，華南受東北季候風影響。
市民應留意天文台最新消息。若雷暴持續或影響其他地區，警告或會延長。
